decisions.reason: The same message already records the required smaller, thinner whisk geometry for fine powder and 2.5-quart bowls; the bowl-capacity change requires no additional candidate-state update.
Specifying 2.5-quart bowls does not change the existing requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
The bowl-capacity and whisk-size decision does not alter the existing splash-control target.
The same message already updates the BOM requirement's whisk selection to smaller, thinner whisks suitable for 2.5-quart bowls; no additional update or removal is required.
The 2.5-quart bowl specification and whisk geometry do not change the beige and green color scheme.
Message 43 does not change the spout's mounting location, orientation, or pouring access; the subsequent spout discussion is a separate source decision.
The precise bowl capacity is owned by the bowl requirement and does not revise the enclosure requirement to preserve the selected thickness while avoiding an overly large box.
The bowl and whisk sizing decision has no effect on the machine placard text.
Changing the bowl capacity and whisk geometry does not modify the requirement for leak-free bowl and spout seals.
The source decision does not change the required isolation of liquid from the base and electrical components.
The 2.5-quart bowl and smaller-whisk decision does not alter the spout's removable or flush-cleanable dispensing path.
The source decision does not change the dispensing valve, drip prevention, or controlled-flow requirements.
